records.source: We're hiding in here so we don't have to talk to anyone.
records.translation: Nagtatago kami rito para hindi na makipag-usap kahit kanino.

records.source: What's up, @? I'm just saying hi to the mom.
records.translation: Ano'ng balita, @? Bumati lang ako kay Mama.

records.source: It's nice to see the ol' gang again. Nothing's changed.$h
records.translation: Masayang makitang magkakasama ulit ang dating barkada. Walang nagbago.$h

records.source: Dad seems to be doing okay without me around.
records.translation: Mukhang ayos naman si Papa kahit wala ako rito.

records.source: Hey, @. I like to relax here... it's so peaceful.
records.translation: Uy, @. Gusto kong magpahinga rito... napakapayapa.

records.source: Urgh... I still can't beat it by myself.$s
records.translation: Argh... Hindi ko pa rin ito matalo nang mag-isa.$s

records.source: Ugh... I have a doctor's appointment later.$s
records.translation: Ugh... May takdang pagpapatingin ako sa doktor mamaya.$s

records.source: I'm just here for my annual check-up! Don't worry, I'm not preg... I mean, I'm not sick! Heh.$9
records.translation: Narito lang ako para sa taunang pagsusuri! Huwag kang mag-alala, hindi ako nagdadal... Ang ibig kong sabihin, hindi ako maysakit! Heh.$9

records.source: How much longer do you need, doc? I'm hungry.$s
records.translation: Gaano ka pa katagal, Dok? Gutom na ako.$s

records.source: This is so mysterious... I love it!
records.translation: Napakamahiwaga nito... Gustong-gusto ko!

records.source: %Alex is completely engrossed in the game. He doesn't notice your presence.
records.translation: %Labis na tutok si Alex sa laro. Hindi niya napapansin ang pagdating mo.

records.source: Hey, @! You can watch the game with us if you want, but no pressure if you're busy.
records.translation: Uy, @! Puwede kang manood ng laro kasama namin kung gusto mo, pero ayos lang kung abala ka.

records.source: I'm going to hang out here all day. My grandparents aren't getting any younger...
records.translation: Dito lang ako buong araw. Hindi na bumabata ang mga lolo't lola ko...

records.source: Hi. Eh, I just twisted my ankle. Seeing if I can get it taped.
records.translation: Kumusta. Ah, napilayan lang ang bukung-bukong ko. Tinitingnan ko kung malalagyan ito ng benda.

records.source: Yeah, yeah... I'm good, doc. Just tape it up, okay?
records.translation: Oo na, oo na... Ayos lang ako, Dok. Bendahan mo lang, sige?

records.source: Have you seen the mermaid show? It's my favorite...
records.translation: Napanood mo na ba ang palabas ng sirena? Paborito ko iyon...

records.source: Finally... A little time to myself.
records.translation: Sa wakas... Kaunting oras para sa sarili ko.

records.source: It was the previous owners who built the altar room. We aren't religious, but we let the other townsfolk use it if they want.
records.translation: Ang mga dating may-ari ang nagtayo ng silid-dasalan. Hindi kami relihiyoso, pero hinahayaan naming gamitin ito ng ibang tagabayan kung gusto nila.

records.source: Hmm... Should I wear something special to the aerobics meet-up today?
records.translation: Hmm... Dapat ba akong magsuot ng espesyal na damit para sa pagtitipon ng aerobics ngayon?

records.source: You're looking really fit, Jodi! Those dumbbells do wonders, don't they?
records.translation: Napakaganda ng pangangatawan mo, Jodi! Malaki ang naitutulong ng mga dumbbell, hindi ba?

records.source: Mmff... I think I've earned some cookies today. *crunch*.
records.translation: Mmff... Sa tingin ko, karapat-dapat ako sa ilang biskuwit ngayon. *langutngot*.

records.source: It's my annual check-up today. At least I don't have to walk very far.
records.translation: Taunang pagsusuri ko ngayon. Mabuti na lang at hindi ako kailangang maglakad nang malayo.

records.source: You're here to see the doctor too? What happened?
records.translation: Magpapatingin ka rin ba sa doktor? Ano ang nangyari?

records.source: Excuse me, I have to say some things to Doctor Harvey in private...$u
records.translation: Paumanhin, may kailangan akong sabihin kay Doktor Harvey nang sarilinan...$u

records.source: I'm getting all my holiday shopping done tonight! Let me know if you see Pierre coming...
records.translation: Tatapusin ko ngayong gabi ang lahat ng pamimili ko para sa pista! Sabihin mo sa akin kung makita mong paparating si Pierre...

records.source: I have a doctor's appointment tomorrow... Maybe the mermaid show will calm my nerves? But what if they think I'm ogling... *gulp*
records.translation: May takdang pagpapatingin ako sa doktor bukas... Baka mapakalma ng palabas ng sirena ang kaba ko? Pero paano kung isipin nilang nakatitig ako nang malaswa... *lunok*

records.source: I have a doctor's appointment today, so if you need to buy anything you'd better hurry.
records.translation: May takdang pagpapatingin ako sa doktor ngayon, kaya magmadali ka kung may kailangan kang bilhin.

records.source: I'm seeing the doctor about my lungs... breathing in all that coal dust can't be good.
records.translation: Magpapatingin ako tungkol sa mga baga ko... hindi makabubuti ang paglanghap ng lahat ng alikabok ng karbon.

records.source: How do my lungs sound, doc? Sometimes they make a rattling sound when I exhale.
records.translation: Ano ang tunog ng mga baga ko, Dok? Minsan ay kumakalansing ang mga ito kapag humihinga ako palabas.

records.source: The colder season is coming up so I'm here to get my flu vaccine.
records.translation: Paparating na ang mas malamig na panahon, kaya narito ako para magpabakuna laban sa trangkaso.

records.source: Doctor Harvey, have you read the latest 'Biology and Medicine'? There's an article I think you'd be interested in.
records.translation: Doktor Harvey, nabasa mo na ba ang pinakabagong “Biyolohiya at Medisina”? May artikulong sa tingin ko ay magugustuhan mo.

records.source: I highly recommend the submarine tour. There are some very fascinating creatures living in the deep ocean.
records.translation: Lubos kong inirerekomenda ang paglilibot sakay ng submarino. May ilang kaakit-akit na nilalang na naninirahan sa malalim na karagatan.

records.source: Hello, @. I'm just watching the waves from here.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Pinagmamasdan ko lang ang mga alon mula rito.

records.source: Hello there. What brings you to this terrible place?
records.translation: Kumusta. Ano ang nagdala sa iyo sa kakila-kilabot na lugar na ito?

records.source: My back has been hurting, doctor... you know, with all the hunching over to write my novel.
records.translation: Masakit ang likod ko, Doktor... alam mo naman, dahil palagi akong nakayuko sa pagsusulat ng nobela ko.

records.source: A fleet of exotic merchants, traveling the world in search of riches beyond imagination... what an adventure!
records.translation: Isang pangkat ng mga kakaibang mangangalakal na naglalakbay sa mundo upang maghanap ng kayamanang lampas sa imahinasyon... napakagandang pakikipagsapalaran!

records.source: What a lovely loom. I'm in heaven right now.
records.translation: Napakagandang habihan. Para akong nasa langit ngayon.

records.source: Can you believe this place?#$e#This is so mysterious...
records.translation: Makapaniwala ka ba sa lugar na ito?#$e#Napakamahiwaga nito...

records.source: That was fun!#$b#I wanna come back soon!$h
records.translation: Masaya iyon!#$b#Gusto kong bumalik agad!$h

records.source: I love being around animals.#$e#This world is full of spirits and magic.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong makasama ang mga hayop.#$e#Punô ng mga espiritu at mahika ang mundong ito.

records.source: Hi Sandy! I got this gift for you. I hope you like it!$h
records.translation: Kumusta, Sandy! May regalo ako para sa iyo. Sana magustuhan mo!$h

records.source: I'm so glad to have a day off from work!$h#$e#I feel content.
records.translation: Tuwang-tuwa akong walang pasok ngayon!$h#$e#Panatag ang loob ko.

records.source: Phew... It's hot!#$e#It seems like a good day to go swimming.#$e#It's probably nice and cool in there.$h
records.translation: Hay... Ang init!#$e#Mukhang magandang araw para lumangoy.#$e#Malamang ay malamig at kaaya-aya roon.$h

records.source: I'm just looking for mermaids.
records.translation: Naghahanap lang ako ng mga sirena.

records.source: I come here to smell the fruit.
records.translation: Pumupunta ako rito upang amuyin ang mga prutas.

records.source: Friday nights are busy, so I'm just helping out for old time's sake. It's fun!$h
records.translation: Abala tuwing Biyernes ng gabi, kaya tumutulong lang ako gaya ng dati. Masaya ito!$h

records.source: It's good to visit the old house. It's full of memories.
records.translation: Masarap dalawin ang dating bahay. Punô ito ng mga alaala.

records.source: I'm trying to get a good walk in today. My legs feel like cannelloni.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong makapaglakad nang maayos ngayon. Parang cannelloni ang mga binti ko.

records.source: Gus seems to have problems organizing everything without me around.
records.translation: Mukhang nahihirapan si Gus na ayusin ang lahat kapag wala ako.

records.source: Most of us visit the doctor for a yearly check-up.
records.translation: Karamihan sa amin ay nagpapatingin sa doktor minsan kada taon.

records.source: Doctor, I'd like to go with the 'natural remedy' if possible.
records.translation: Doktor, gusto ko sana ng “likas na lunas” kung maaari.

records.source: I think this boat's my favorite. It's so unique!
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, paborito ko ang bangkang ito. Napakanatatangi!

records.source: When you get to be my age you have to see the doctor more often.
records.translation: Kapag kasing-edad mo na ako, kailangan mong magpatingin sa doktor nang mas madalas.

records.source: Oh dear, is it an emergency? Why are you here?$s
records.translation: Naku, may emerhensiya ba? Bakit ka narito?$s

records.source: Now now, dear... It's important that Doctor Harvey takes a good look at you. He's a nice young man! Behave yourself, for your dear old wife's sake.
records.translation: Aba, mahal... Mahalagang masuri ka nang mabuti ni Doktor Harvey. Mabait siyang binata! Magpakabait ka para sa matagal mo nang pinakamamahal na asawa.
